channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 26
item.description:
41 development commits

No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 25
item.description:
167 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Recoil duration reduced by 75% on most weapons, making sustained fire feel more controllable.

Movement & Controls

  • Strafing now cancels sprint, and a crouch‑strafe bug has been fixed.
  • Boat and cargo parenting bugs fixed: players no longer unintentionally transfer to cargo ships, exclusion zones prevent attachment to moving excavator arms, and ladder climbing from boats no longer drags players off.

Building & Structures

  • Gingerbread physics material added to low and half walls, affecting building physics for gingerbread structures.

Trading & Crate System

  • Tradable skin bundles now retain their tradeable status, fixing incorrect non‑tradable markings.
  • Crate generators are now correctly recognized as bundles, ensuring proper operation within the bundle system.

Tech Tree & UI

  • Tech‑tree shuffled with a new in‑editor graph editor and reorganised tier 1‑3 trees for Hardcore and Primitive modes; UI now opens up to eight times faster, cutting load time from ~1.2 s to ~0.15 s.

Boss & NPC Physics

  • Scrap King’s physics material changed to metal, altering its interactions and damage handling.

Customization

  • New console variable lets players hide all tattoos

Lighting & Visuals

  • Brightness transition at dawn and dusk is smoother
  • Night light now works correctly with the anti‑gamma fix
  • Added foreground and background floor geometry for night shadows to prevent gamma spikes; includes a toggle convar

Gameplay & Balance

  • Sprint mechanics have been updated to the modern movement system, changing acceleration and stamina behavior for faster, smoother running.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 24
item.description:
157 development commits

Gameplay Buffs & Mechanics

  • Added a performance buff to the thruster module.
  • Renovation now recharges only in its own tool cupboard base.
  • Softcore raid window countdown now functions correctly, no longer stuck at zero.

NPC & AI Improvements

  • Human NPCs now aim upright, improving combat accuracy.

World Generation & Spawning

  • Crocodile spawn attempts increased for reliable appearances in swamps and rivers; vegetation no longer respawns inside junkpiles, preventing hidden resources.
  • Beach spawn gap exemptions fixed on bundled servers, ensuring proper spawn behavior.

Navigation & UI Enhancements

  • Dynamic markers now appear on monuments, improving navigation and awareness.

Marketplace & Bundles

  • Workshop skins can be sold as bundles, displayed with combined icons, and bundled skins are hidden from regular store search.
  • Bundle contents now sync with Steam schema; tradable skin bundles are purchasable again.

World & Gameplay

  • River generation now respects new exclusion zones around fishing villages, preventing rivers from spawning directly through village layouts.
  • Tattoos remain saved when a player disconnects while dead, persisting through reconnection.
  • Satellite wrecks no longer keep flames when they land in water, removing lingering fire hazards.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Vendor UI counters now display correctly, fixing missing or clipped item counts at fishing villages and bandit camps.
  • Session page now includes a functional disconnect button, restores the website link, and shows the full server image.
  • Greyscale toggle and save button now work correctly, with the save button properly closing the menu.
  • Contact list notes are now saved correctly, fixing the issue where notes were lost on Enter/Escape.
  • Tattoo UI spinner wheel visibility fixed, ensuring the loading indicator appears correctly.
  • Tattoo menu buttons now respond correctly and inventory preview shows fade effect, improving tattoo selection.
  • Multiple tattoo-related bugs addressed, reducing errors when applying or previewing tattoos.

New Content

  • M939 Truck now spawns at the Nuclear Missile Silo Monument, providing a new vehicle option.

Building & Construction

  • Window embrasure workshop prefabs are now available and positioned correctly, making construction easier.

Gameplay & Persistence

  • Contact notes now save reliably, preventing loss of player contact information.
